This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines a historical time period with a second “time of” expression; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人：看到很多人，Here the intended meaning is “see many people,” not “look at many people,” so the resultative complement is needed. [rule: resultative_complement]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
一看很多人 is an incomplete 一……就-style fragment here, while 看到很多人 is a correct verb phrase.
